sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, FNF: Trick or Die is a platformer game, and as such, it relies heavily on its core gameplay mechanics. Players control their character, who must navigate through increasingly challenging levels to rescue Girlfriend from Lemon Demon. The gameplay is fast-paced and action-packed, with players needing to think on their feet and react quickly to changing situations. To overcome obstacles and defeat enemies, players must press keys in time with the music, adding a whole new level of depth and challenge to the game.

One of the standout features of FNF: Trick or Die is its intuitive controls. Players can use the W-A-S-D keys to move, the F key to pick up or use an item, and the G key to drop an item. The T key is used to unhide, which is a useful feature that allows players to reveal hidden areas or pick up items that were previously invisible. The controls are responsive and easy to use, making it easy for players to get started and quickly pick up the game.

The game also features a variety of items and power-ups that players can collect to help them on their journey. These items can give players a temporary boost, such as increased speed or invincibility, or provide a more permanent advantage, such as a new ability or a boost to their health. Players must carefully manage their inventory and use their items wisely in order to succeed.

While the core gameplay mechanics of FNF: Trick or Die are engaging and fun, they do become a bit repetitive at times. Players will find themselves doing the same actions over and over again, such as navigating through identical-looking levels or fighting the same enemies. However, the game's clever use of rhythm and timing keeps the gameplay fresh and exciting, even after multiple playthroughs.
